candidats.titre: File:DFC 0167 An old building facade with a large rooftop sign in Thai script against a blue sky framed by green foliage in the foreground.jpg
candidats.description: This photo shows an old building with what appears to be Thai script signage on top. The sign is mounted on a metal framework above a weathered concrete structure with a flat roof. The building has a somewhat aged appearance with visible wear on its white walls. In the foreground, there are lush green tropical plants with some white flowers visible on the left side. The scene is set against a blue sky with scattered white clouds, suggesting it was taken during daytime in Thailand or another Southeast Asian country. candidats.titre: File:Old Delaware State House, The Green, Dover, DE - 54435261899.jpg
candidats.description: Built in 1787-1792, this Georgian-style building was designed by John Howe, and built to serve as the state capitol of Delaware, replacing a courthouse that had stood on the site since 1722. The building was originally utilized as the Kent County Courthouse and Delaware State Capitol, with the original building being expanded with a rear wing to the east in 1835, which has since been removed. In 1873-1875, the building was extensively renovated in the then-fashionable Second Empire style, adding a tower and mansard roof, and significantly altering the window bays on the front (western) facade,
